title: LeadEnforce | Are Advantage+ Shopping Campaigns Good for Small E-commerce Brands?

facts.fact: The article states that advertisers can upload up to 150 creative pieces to an Advantage+ shopping campaign.
facts.quote: You can upload up to 150 creative pieces — but quality matters more than quantity.

facts.fact: The article's chart illustrates Meta's Advantage+ campaigns allocating spend 60% to clicks, 25% to add-to-carts, and 15% to purchases.
facts.quote: Horizontal bar chart showing how Meta’s Advantage+ campaigns allocate spend: 60% to clicks, 25% to add-to-carts, and 15% to purchases

facts.fact: The article recommends starting an Advantage+ campaign with 10–20% of the total budget.
facts.quote: Start with 10–20% of your total budget.

facts.fact: The article recommends watching Advantage+ results over the first 7–10 days before deciding whether to increase the budget.
facts.quote: Watch your results over the first 7–10 days.

facts.fact: The article was published on January 27, 2026.
